title: Too Thin and Uncomfortable Under Feet. Disappointing Maximum Heat Output. Not USB.
text:
Too Thin and Uncomfortable Under Feet. Disappointing Maximum Heat Output. Not USB.. This is too thin, where if you rest your feet on it, it is uncomfortable because you can feel the hard wires under your feet.

Also, this does not produce the stated heat of 119 degrees. It only gets to 105 degrees.

Also, at the time I purchased this, the details stated USB charging. It is not USB at all.

product_metadata.title: Electric Blanket Heating Cushion Heated Multifunctional Electric Winter Warm Heating Blanket Office Home Chair Pad Mat 6-speed Temperature Control and 4 Time Settings Safe and Comfortable to Use(US)
features: ❥ Fast heating: The heated blanket can hug you fully and steadily. It can be heated quickly to withstand cold weather to the greatest extent. It is a necessary equipment in winter. When you read, watch TV, and work, you will no longer feel cold.

❥ Safety protection: 6-level temperature control of the heated seat cushion to meet the requirements of different people for different temperatures in different environments. 4 time setting (30min, 60min, 90min, 120min) to prevent overheating and burning. Maximum protection of users' safety.

❥ Soft and comfortable: One side of velvet flannel and the other side of Sherpa flannel bring the best comfort. Both sides work effectively to keep heat, so as to further keep warm, soft, breathable, comfortable and non-fading.

❥ Convenient charging: The heating cushion adopts USB charging, which saves electricity, energy and safety, and can be used for a long time. Overheating protection can provide a safer user experience for the electric blanket.

❥ Washable: The detachable controller and washable fabric material of the heating blanket will help keep the electric heating blanket hygienic and soft in the next few years, easy to clean and prolong its service life.
